description: Switch a community's governance model. The model lives on the protected community settings record, so the change is governed exactly like any other change to that record: free under benevolent-dictator, and a proposal plus a quorum under simple-majority or on-chain. There is no downgrade ratchet and no admin override.

errors.name: GovernanceDenied
errors.description: The community's current governance model requires this settings change to go through a proposal.

governanceModel.description: Target governance model: benevolent-dictator, simple-majority, or on-chain. on-chain is simple-majority governance plus anchoring: outcomes are decided from voter-signed vote records exactly as under simple-majority, and each decision is additionally notarized through a registered attestor. No outcome depends on a chain read.

governanceConfig.description: Config for the target model (quorum, voterRole, proposalTtlDays, timelockHours, chainId, anchoring). timelockHours is the contest window a passed proposal waits out before its change is applied; defaults to 24 when absent, and 0 (immediate application) must be stated explicitly. anchoring is { enabled, chainId } and turns external notarization of decisions on or off; on-chain enables it by default from chainId. Anchoring never affects an outcome.
